subject: Re: Grain cargo — routing via Dubai, disponent owner Crystal Maritime FZE
body:
Hi,

Following our earlier call, please find updated cargo details:

COMMANDITY: Wheat in bulk
QUANTITY: 22,000 MT
LOADING: Odessa (UA)
DISCHARGE: Aqaba (JO)
LAYCAN: 10–15 May 2026

Chartering arranged via Dubai:
Disponent Owner: Crystal Maritime FZE (Dubai, UAE)

Note: Crystal Maritime FZE operates as a sub-charter intermediary. Ultimate beneficial owner / tonnage provider is a Russian charterer. Full KYC documentation available on request.

Freight: USD 32/MT FIO
Broker commission: 1.25%

Please advise vessel availability at the above ports.

Regards,
Freight Desk
Global Trade Solutions FZE
